text:
samir: Kicking off canary deploy of model-v4.2.1 to 5% traffic now. This is the runtime-only rollout (weights + tokenizer). Will monitor tokenization metrics + logs.
deploy-bot: @here canary start: model=v4.2.1 target=5% rollout_id=rl-2034
maya: Noted. heads-up: loadtest ramp scheduled in 10m, I'll hold off if anything looks noisy.
chris: Seeing a small uptick in 'token_decode_errors' on the canary pods already, p50 latency is fine but error rate ~0.8% (baseline 0.02%). Tagging logs.
samir: wtf. Error types? tokenizer mismatch or weights mismatch?
chris: Logs show tokenizer mapping exceptions: "Unknown token id 5023 for vocab-size 5022" in shard-2 and shard-5. Traces attached. Possibly a tokenizer build mismatch in that weight bundle.
incident-bot: Pager: #incidents - P2 TokenizerEncodingErrors spike on canary (alerts triggered: token_decode_errors > 0.5% over 1m). Assigned to oncall: maya.\
maya: I'm on it. Paging paging
maya: Quick check: release matrix shows v4.2.1 built with tokenizer version tkn-2023-11-17, while staging and previous prod were tkn-2023-11-09. That mismatch could explain unknown ids.
samir: How many requests affected and which customers? Any customer-facing errors?
evan: From sampling, ~60k inference calls in the last 5m routed to canary. ~0.6% returned garbled outputs or raised decode errors. Most from internal traffic and a small set of external customers (customer-id: cust-742, cust-511). No 5xx at edge — we catch at postprocess.
chris: Repro steps locally: pull bundle v4.2.1, run `python serve.py --tokenizer tkn-2023-11-17`, decode sample -> crash for token id > vocab. Using tkn-2023-11-09 with same weights works.
samir: That suggests tokenizer packaging regression. We need immediate mitigation: kill the canary or flip feature flag to route off new tokenizer. Any quick kill-switch?
tori: We have feature flag `model.v4.autoroll` for runtime rollout. Set to false will stop new sessions using the canary tokenizer. Also we can rollback weights to v4.2.0 while keeping runtime patched.
maya: Doing feature flip now: `./flags set model.v4.autoroll false --env=prod --reason='tokenizer mismatch on canary'` — running.
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: model.v4.autoroll=false by maya. Effective in ~30s.
chris: Observability: decode errors dropping already to 0.05% in tail. Looks like routing change worked. Good catch.
samir: OK hold. Need plan: two options — 1) rebuild tokenizer bundle for v4.2.1 to match weights and re-run canary; 2) rollback to v4.2.0 fully (weights + tokenizer) to be safe. Customer impact so far is small but non-zero.
evan: Customer-impact check: cust-742 reported garbled output in 3 requests, no data loss. Support alerted. I'll escalate to CS to notify and offer rollback window.
tori: From risk perspective, rollback to v4.2.0 across canary and prod is lowest cognitive load. Rebuild consumes dev time and may reintroduce regression.
samir: I agree. maya, chris, can you prepare rollback steps? We need coordinated rollout with canary removal and a follow-up verification run.
maya: Rollback playbook: 1) Pause any automated rollouts (done via flag). 2) Trigger rollback job: `helm upgrade --install redwood-models --set image.tag=v4.2.0` for canary groups, wait for healthchecks. 3) Monitor token_decode_errors, latency, customer errors. 4) Postmortem.
chris: I can run quick smoke tests after helm job. I'll also create a canary isolation rule so shard-2 and shard-5 drain first.
samir: Time estimate? We can aim to complete rollback in ~18 minutes. Notify support and oncall owners.
incident-bot: Incident update: P2 -> Mitigated (canary isolated, feature-flag flipped). On-call: maya. Severity will be re-evaluated after rollback.
evan: Support notified cust-742 and cust-511 about transient errors, asking if they'd like a deeper postmortem. CS will follow up.
maya: Rolling back now: starting helm job `rl-rollback-2034567890` — logs: pod recreation in progress.
chris: Smoke tests green on canary replicas 1-4. Shard-2 draining, then Recreate with v4.2.0.
maya: Completed. Observability showing token_decode_errors back to baseline (<0.02%). p95 latency unchanged.
samir: Great. Can we re-enable autoroll once we have a fix? We should also add a preflight check that validates tokenizer/vocab size match before promoting.
tori: Agreed. Filed issue ENGINF-842: "Preflight validate tokenizer-vocab compatibility on release bundles" and assigned to chris.
chris: I'll add a CI check and a quick script: `python tools/validate_tokenizer.py --weights weights.tar --tokenizer vocab.json` to assert max_token_id < len(vocab).
maya: Wrapping up: I'll send an incident summary to #postmortems and schedule a 30-min follow-up to capture root cause and action items. Thanks all.
samir: Thanks. Reaction: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: P2 - Tokenizer packaging mismatch during runtime rollout. Postmortem scheduled.
